component.name: jsBudbrainAssemblerIDE
component.summary: Assembler IDE: write, build, debug and disassemble x86 programs

description.p: Write x86 assembler programs, build them with NASM and step through them in the built-in debugger — and look into any binary: machine code and assembler side by side, both editable.

ul.li: Editor with NASM colours, completion, search and replace, rename and go to definition
Debugger: single steps, breakpoints, registers, flags, watched expressions and memory watchpoints
Every step shows what it changed — registers, flags, memory
Hex and assembler view of any program, editable and searchable
Disassemble programs into source code that builds again
Reference for every instruction, directive, system call and error code

screenshot.caption: Step through your program and see what every instruction changed
Schritt für Schritt durchs Programm – und sehen, was jeder Befehl verändert
Machine code and assembler side by side, searchable and editable
Maschinencode und Assembler nebeneinander, durchsuchbar und änderbar
A reference for every instruction, system call and error code
Nachschlagen: jeder Befehl, jeder Systemaufruf, jeder Fehlercode
A compiled C program turned back into assembler source
Ein übersetztes C-Programm, zurückverwandelt in Assembler-Quelltext
Completion while you type, in light or dark
Vervollständigung beim Tippen, hell oder dunkel

description.p: The start screen is drawn cleanly again, the first window opens larger, and the window is found by tools that look for it by name.
